```{r Load packages and data}

survey_dat2 <- read.csv("survey_dat2.csv")
```

```{r Clean Data}

#Make sure season is a factor
survey_dat2$season <- as.character(survey_dat2$season)

#Generate hunting index
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs=="No"]<- 0
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs=="Yes"] <- 1

survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores=="No"]<- 0
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores=="Yes"] <- 1

survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds=="No"]<- 0
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds=="Yes"] <- 1

survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs=="No"]<- 0
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs=="Yes"] <- 1

survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs<- as.numeric(survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs)
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds<- as.numeric(survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds)
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores<- as.numeric(survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores)
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs<- as.numeric(survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs)

survey_dat2$hunted_trapped <- as.integer(
  survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs == 1 |
  survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_lemurs == 1 |
  survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores == 1 |
  survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds == 1|
   survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs == 1 
)

#Select relevant covariates
survey_dat2 <- survey_dat2%>% dplyr::select(hunted_trapped, age, season, amount_vanilla_harvested, amount_vanilla_lost, village, house_sol, commercial_goods, gender, crops_vanilla, cert_member, log_commercial) %>% drop_na(age)

#Get village dummy variables
survey_dat2$villageMandena <- survey_dat2$village
survey_dat2$villageMandena[survey_dat2$villageMandena=="Mandena"] <- 1
survey_dat2$villageMandena[survey_dat2$villageMandena!="1"] <- 0
survey_dat2$villageMandena <- as.numeric(survey_dat2$villageMandena)
survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano <- survey_dat2$village
survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano[survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano=="Sarahandrano"] <- 1
survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano[survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano!="1"] <- 0
survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano <- as.numeric(survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano)

survey_dat2$log_vanilla <- scale(log(survey_dat2$amount_vanilla_harvested+1)) 

#Get dataframe that only includes people who had a vanilla harvest and prep for analysis
survey_dat3 <- survey_dat2 %>% filter(amount_vanilla_harvested > 0)
survey_dat3$log_vanilla <- scale(log(survey_dat3$amount_vanilla_harvested+1)) #variable for amount of vanilla harvested
survey_dat3$village <- as.factor(survey_dat3$village)
X <- model.matrix(~ village, data = survey_dat3)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
colnames(X)
survey_dat3x <- cbind(survey_dat3, X)
survey_dat3x$villageMandena <- as.factor(survey_dat3x$villageMandena)
survey_dat3x$villageSarahandrano <- as.factor(survey_dat3x$villageSarahandrano)
survey_dat3x$cert_member[survey_dat3x$cert_member=="Yes"] <- 1
survey_dat3x$cert_member[survey_dat3x$cert_member=="No"] <- 0
survey_dat3x$cert_member <- as.numeric(survey_dat3x$cert_member)


#Get dataframe that only includes people who lost part of their vanilla harvest and prepare for analysis
survey_dat4 <- survey_dat2 %>% drop_na(amount_vanilla_lost) %>% filter(crops_vanilla==1) #filter(amount_vanilla_lost > 0)

survey_dat4$log_vanilla_pct_loss <- scale(log(survey_dat4$vanilla_pct_loss+1))

X <- model.matrix(~ village, data = survey_dat4)[, -1, drop = FALSE]

survey_dat4x$cert_member <- as.numeric(survey_dat4x$cert_member)
survey_dat4x$log_vanilla <- log(survey_dat4x$amount_vanilla_harvested+1)




survey_dat6 <- survey_dat2 %>% filter(crops_vanilla==1)
```

```{r Vanilla farmer binary SEM}

survey_dat2$hunted_trapped <- ordered(survey_dat2$hunted_trapped)
survey_dat2$house_sol      <- as.numeric(survey_dat2$house_sol)

# ---- 1) Define the SEM  ----
model_multi_binary <- '
  log_commercial ~ a1*crops_vanilla + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
  house_sol      ~ crops_vanilla + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
  log_commercial ~~ house_sol
  hunted_trapped ~ b1*log_commercial + house_sol +
                   c*crops_vanilla + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena + gender + age

  # --- Indirect effects of crops_vanilla ---
  ind_goods_van := a1*b1
  direct_van    := c
  total_van     := direct_van + ind_goods_van
'

# ---- 2) Fit the SEM  ----
fit_multi_binary <- sem(
  model_multi_binary,
  data      = survey_dat2,
  ordered   = c("hunted_trapped"),
  estimator = "WLSMV"
)

# ---- 3) Inspect effects ----
summary(fit_multi_binary, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)

obs <- lavInspect(fit_multi_binary, "sampstat")[[1]]
imp <- lavInspect(fit_multi_binary, "implied")[[1]]
resid_mat <- obs - imp
resid_mat

# ---- 4) Plot ----
pe95_binary <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_binary, ci = TRUE, level = 0.95)
pe90_binary <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_binary, ci = TRUE, level = 0.90)
pe80_binary <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_binary, ci = TRUE, level = 0.80)

keep_labs <- c("ind_goods_van", "direct_van", "total_van")

eff95_binary <- pe95_binary %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, est, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(Estimate = est, CI95_Lower = ci.lower, CI95_Upper = ci.upper)

eff90_binary <- pe90_binary %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(CI90_Lower = ci.lower, CI90_Upper = ci.upper)

eff80_binary <- pe80_binary %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(CI80_Lower = ci.lower, CI80_Upper = ci.upper)

eff_df_binary <- eff95_binary %>%
  left_join(eff90_binary, by = "label") %>%
  left_join(eff80_binary, by = "label") %>%
  mutate(
    Effect = dplyr::recode(label,
      ind_goods_van = "Indirect:\nGoods",
      direct_van    = "Direct",
      total_van     = "Total"
    ),
    Effect = factor(Effect, levels = c("Total", "Direct", "Indirect:\nGoods"))
  )

binary_plot <- ggplot(eff_df_binary, aes(x = Effect, y = Estimate, color = Effect)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI95_Lower, ymax = CI95_Upper),
                  linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI90_Lower, ymax = CI90_Upper),
                  linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI80_Lower, ymax = CI80_Upper),
                  linewidth = 2.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Effect of vanilla farming (binary)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "black", "purple3"))



```

```{r Vanilla Harvest Amount SEM}

survey_dat2$vanilla_grower <- survey_dat2$amount_vanilla_harvested 
survey_dat2$vanilla_grower[survey_dat2$vanilla_grower!=0] <- 1

survey_dat2$hunted_trapped <- ordered(survey_dat2$hunted_trapped)

survey_dat5 <- survey_dat2 %>% filter(crops_vanilla ==1)

model_multi <- '
  log_vanilla    ~ d1*cert_member + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
  log_commercial ~ a1*log_vanilla + g1*cert_member + 
                   villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
  house_sol      ~ log_vanilla  + cert_member + 
                   villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
  log_commercial ~~ house_sol
  hunted_trapped ~ b1*log_commercial + house_sol +
                   c*log_vanilla + h1*cert_member +
                   villageSarahandrano + villageMandena + gender + age

  # --- Indirect effects of log_vanilla ---
  ind_goods_van  := a1*b1
  direct_van     := c
  total_van      := direct_van + ind_goods_van

  # --- Indirect effects of cert_member ---
  ind_cert_goods_only := g1*b1
  ind_cert_van_only   := d1*c
  ind_cert_van_goods  := d1*a1*b1
  ind_cert_total := ind_cert_goods_only + ind_cert_van_only + ind_cert_van_goods
  direct_cert := h1
  total_cert  := direct_cert + ind_cert_total
'

fit_multi <- sem(
  model_multi,
  data      = survey_dat5,
  ordered   = c("hunted_trapped"),
  estimator = "WLSMV"
)

summary(fit_multi, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)

obs <- lavInspect(fit_multi, "sampstat")[[1]]
imp <- lavInspect(fit_multi, "implied")[[1]]
resid_mat <- obs - imp
resid_mat


# ---- 4) Plot
pe95 <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi, ci = TRUE, level = 0.95)
pe90 <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi, ci = TRUE, level = 0.90)
pe80 <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi, ci = TRUE, level = 0.80)

keep_labs <- c("ind_goods_van","ind_house_van","ind_total_van","direct_van","total_van")

eff95 <- pe95 %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, est, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(Estimate = est, CI95_Lower = ci.lower, CI95_Upper = ci.upper)

eff90 <- pe90 %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(CI90_Lower = ci.lower, CI90_Upper = ci.upper)

eff80 <- pe80 %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(CI80_Lower = ci.lower, CI80_Upper = ci.upper)


keep_labs <- c("ind_goods_van", "direct_van", "total_van")

eff_df <- eff95 %>%
  left_join(eff90, by = "label") %>%
  left_join(eff80, by = "label") %>%
  mutate(
    Effect = dplyr::recode(label,
      ind_goods_van  = "Indirect:\nGoods",
      direct_van     = "Direct",
      total_van      = "Total"
    ),
    Effect = factor(
      Effect,
      levels = c("Total", "Direct", "Indirect:\nGoods")
    )
  )

harvest_plot <- ggplot(eff_df, aes(x = Effect, y = Estimate, color = Effect)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI95_Lower, ymax = CI95_Upper),
                  linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI90_Lower, ymax = CI90_Upper),
                  linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI80_Lower, ymax = CI80_Upper),
                  linewidth = 2.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Effect of log(vanilla harvest)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "black", "purple3"))



```

```{r Vanilla Harvest Loss SEM}

survey_dat4x$h_sol_harvest <- survey_dat4x$house_sol * survey_dat4x$log_vanilla
survey_dat4x$h_sol_loss<- survey_dat4x$house_sol * survey_dat4x$log_vanilla_pct_loss

survey_dat4x$hunted_trapped <- ordered(survey_dat4x$hunted_trapped)


# ---- 1) Define the SEM ----
model_multi_lost <- '
  log_vanilla_pct_loss ~ d1*cert_member + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
  log_vanilla          ~ d2*cert_member + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena

  log_commercial ~ a1*log_vanilla_pct_loss + a3*log_vanilla +
                   g1*cert_member + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
  house_sol      ~ log_vanilla_pct_loss + log_vanilla +
                   cert_member + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena

  log_vanilla_pct_loss ~~ log_vanilla
  log_commercial ~~ house_sol

  hunted_trapped ~ b1*log_commercial + house_sol +
                   c1*log_vanilla_pct_loss + c2*log_vanilla +
                   h1*cert_member +
                   villageSarahandrano + villageMandena + gender + age

  # --- Indirect effects of log_vanilla_pct_loss ---
  ind_goods_vanloss := a1*b1
  direct_vanloss    := c1
  total_vanloss     := direct_vanloss + ind_goods_vanloss

  # --- Indirect effects of log_vanilla ---
  ind_goods_van := a3*b1
  direct_van    := c2
  total_van     := direct_van + ind_goods_van

  # --- Indirect effects of cert_member ---
  ind_cert_goods_only    := g1*b1
  ind_cert_vanloss_only  := d1*c1
  ind_cert_van_only      := d2*c2
  ind_cert_vanloss_goods := d1*a1*b1
  ind_cert_van_goods     := d2*a3*b1
  ind_cert_total := ind_cert_goods_only +
                    ind_cert_vanloss_only + ind_cert_van_only +
                    ind_cert_vanloss_goods + ind_cert_van_goods
  direct_cert := h1
  total_cert  := direct_cert + ind_cert_total
'

# ---- 2) Fit the SEM ----
fit_multi_lost <- sem(
  model_multi_lost,
  data      = survey_dat4x,
  ordered   = c("hunted_trapped"),
  estimator = "WLSMV"
)

# ---- 3) Inspect effects ----
summary(fit_multi_lost, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
obs <- lavInspect(fit_multi_lost, "sampstat")[[1]]
imp <- lavInspect(fit_multi_lost, "implied")[[1]]
resid_mat <- obs - imp
resid_mat

# ---- 4) Plot ----
pe95_lost <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_lost, ci = TRUE, level = 0.95)
pe90_lost <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_lost, ci = TRUE, level = 0.90)
pe80_lost <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_lost, ci = TRUE, level = 0.80)

keep_labs <- c("ind_goods_vanloss", "direct_vanloss", "total_vanloss")

eff95_lost <- pe95_lost %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, est, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(Estimate = est, CI95_Lower = ci.lower, CI95_Upper = ci.upper)

eff90_lost <- pe90_lost %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(CI90_Lower = ci.lower, CI90_Upper = ci.upper)

eff80_lost <- pe80_lost %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(CI80_Lower = ci.lower, CI80_Upper = ci.upper)

eff_df_lost <- eff95_lost %>%
  left_join(eff90_lost, by = "label") %>%
  left_join(eff80_lost, by = "label") %>%
  mutate(
    Effect = dplyr::recode(label,
      ind_goods_vanloss = "Indirect:\nGoods",
      direct_vanloss    = "Direct",
      total_vanloss     = "Total"
    ),
    Effect = factor(Effect, levels = c("Total", "Direct", "Indirect:\nGoods"))
  )

lost_plot <- ggplot(eff_df_lost, aes(x = Effect, y = Estimate, color = Effect)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI95_Lower, ymax = CI95_Upper),
                  linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI90_Lower, ymax = CI90_Upper),
                  linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI80_Lower, ymax = CI80_Upper),
                  linewidth = 2.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Effect of % lost vanilla harvest") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "black", "purple3"))
```

```{r Binary DAG}
# --- Settings ---
goods_var <- "log_commercial"
vanilla   <- "crops_vanilla"
outcome   <- "hunted_trapped"
alpha     <- 0.1

# --- 1) Extract regressions ---
pe    <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_binary, standardized = FALSE)
V     <- vcov(fit_multi_binary)
edges <- subset(pe, op == "~")

# Drop control variables and all house_sol paths
drop_from <- c("gender","age","villageSarahandrano","villageMandena","house_sol")
edges <- edges[!(edges$rhs %in% drop_from), ]
edges <- edges[edges$lhs != "house_sol", ]

# --- 2) Significance and labels ---
edges$signif <- edges$pvalue < alpha
stars <- cut(edges$pvalue,
             breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
             labels = c("***","**","*","+",""), right = FALSE)
edges$lab <- paste0(round(edges$est, 2), stars)

# Default styling
edges$col     <- "black"
edges$fontcol <- "black"
edges$pw      <- 1.6
edges$style   <- "solid"

# Color goods paths purple
is_goods <- edges$rhs == goods_var | edges$lhs == goods_var
edges$col[is_goods]     <- "purple3"
edges$fontcol[is_goods] <- "purple3"

# --- 2b) All paths shown at full opacity ---
edges$acol     <- edges$col
edges$afontcol <- edges$fontcol

# --- 3) Nodes ---
vars <- sort(unique(c(edges$lhs, edges$rhs)))
labels <- c(
  log_commercial = "Goods",
  crops_vanilla  = "Vanilla Farmer\n(Binary)",
  hunted_trapped = "Hunted/Trapped",
  cert_member    = "Certification\nMember"
)
node_lab <- setNames(vars, vars)
for (nm in names(labels)) { if (nm %in% vars) node_lab[nm] <- labels[[nm]] }

node_fill   <- setNames(rep("white", length(vars)), vars)
node_font   <- setNames(rep("black", length(vars)), vars)
node_border <- setNames(rep("black", length(vars)), vars)

if (goods_var %in% vars) {
  node_fill[goods_var]   <- "purple3"
  node_font[goods_var]   <- "white"
  node_border[goods_var] <- "purple3"
}

esc <- function(x) gsub('"', '\\"', x)

# --- 4) Build edges (direct only, no indirect arrows) ---
all_edges <- data.frame(
  rhs     = edges$rhs,
  lhs     = edges$lhs,
  lab     = edges$lab,
  col     = edges$acol,
  fontcol = edges$afontcol,
  pw      = edges$pw,
  style   = edges$style,
  dir     = "forward",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# --- 5) Build DOT & render ---
dot <- paste0(
  'digraph G {\n',
  '  graph [rankdir=LR, splines=spline, nodesep="0.4", ranksep="0.6"];\n',
  '  node  [shape=box, fontname="Helvetica", style=filled];\n',
  '  edge  [fontname="Helvetica"];\n',
  paste(sprintf('  "%s" [label="%s", fillcolor="%s", fontcolor="%s", color="%s"];',
                vars, esc(unname(node_lab[vars])),
                unname(node_fill[vars]), unname(node_font[vars]), unname(node_border[vars])),
        collapse = "\n"), '\n',
  paste(sprintf(
    '  "%s" -> "%s" [label="%s", color="%s", fontcolor="%s", penwidth=%s, style="%s", dir="%s"];',
    all_edges$rhs, all_edges$lhs, esc(all_edges$lab),
    all_edges$col, all_edges$fontcol, all_edges$pw, all_edges$style, all_edges$dir
  ), collapse = "\n"),
  '\n}'
)

binary_vanilla_path <- grViz(dot)
```

```{r}

results_binary <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_binary, standardized = TRUE)
results_table_binary <- results_binary[, c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "est", "se", "pvalue")]
results_table_binary$Model <- "Binary"

results_amount <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi, standardized = TRUE)
results_table_amount <- results_amount[, c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "est", "se", "pvalue")]
results_table_amount$Model <- "Amount Harvested"

results_cert <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_cert, standardized = TRUE)
results_table_cert <- results_cert[, c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "est", "se", "pvalue")]
results_table_cert$Model <- "Certification Program"

results_lost <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_lost, standardized = TRUE)
results_table_lost <- results_lost[, c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "est", "se", "pvalue")]
results_table_lost$Model <- "Harvest Lost"

results_combined <- rbind(results_table_binary, results_table_amount, results_table_cert, results_table_lost)
colnames(results_combined) <- c("Dependent Variable", "Operator", "Predictor Variable", "Estimate", "Standard Error", "P-Value", "Model")

results_combined <- results_combined %>% dplyr::select(Model, `Dependent Variable`:`P-Value`)

write.csv(results_combined, "sem_results_combined_updated.csv")

```

```{r}

eff_df_cert$Model <- "Certification Program\n(Binary)"
eff_df$Model      <- "log(Vanilla Harvest)"
eff_df_lost$Model <- "log(% Vanilla\nCrop Lost)"
eff_df_binary$Model <- "Vanilla Farmer\n(Binary)"

eff_df_total <- rbind(eff_df_binary,eff_df, eff_df_cert, eff_df_lost)
eff_df_total$Model <- factor(eff_df_total$Model, levels = c("Vanilla Farmer\n(Binary)",
  "Certification Program\n(Binary)",
  "log(Vanilla Harvest)",
  "log(% Vanilla\nCrop Lost)"
))

total_plot <- ggplot(eff_df_total[eff_df_total$Effect == "Total", ],
                     aes(x = Model, y = Estimate)) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = CI95_Lower, ymax = CI95_Upper),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = CI90_Lower, ymax = CI90_Upper),
    linewidth = 1.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = CI80_Lower, ymax = CI80_Upper),
    linewidth = 2.0,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Estimated Total Effect on\nHunting/Trapping Wildlife") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

indirect_plot <- ggplot(
  eff_df_total[eff_df_total$Effect == "Indirect:\nGoods", ],
  aes(x = Model, y = Estimate)
) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = CI95_Lower, ymax = CI95_Upper),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "purple3",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = CI90_Lower, ymax = CI90_Upper),
    linewidth = 1.2,
    color = "purple3",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = CI80_Lower, ymax = CI80_Upper),
    linewidth = 2.0,
    color = "purple3",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Estimated Indirect Effect\n(via Commercial Goods)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

vanilla_hunting_coef <- ggarrange(total_plot, indirect_plot, labels = c("a", "b"), ncol = 1)


ggsave("vanilla_hunting_coef2.png", vanilla_hunting_coef,
       width = 5, height = 9, dpi = 1000)


```
